subject: ela
cluster: Research to Build and Present Knowledge

items.prompt:
Using a source's exact words in quotation marks is:
A) quoting
B) paraphrasing
C) summarizing

steps: Word for word. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Restating an idea in your own words is:
A) paraphrasing
B) quoting
C) copying

When you paraphrase a source, you:
A) still must cite it
B) never cite it
C) can claim it as yours

An AUTHORITATIVE source is one that is:
A) written by an expert or trusted institution
B) anonymous
C) a joke site
items.answer: A) written by an expert or trusted institution

solution.answer: A) written by an expert or trusted institution

items.prompt:
Which search terms are MOST effective for finding how coral reefs recover from bleaching?
A) 'coral reef bleaching recovery'
B) 'ocean stuff'
C) 'cool fish'

Integrating information SELECTIVELY means:
A) including only the most relevant details and keeping the flow
B) copying everything
C) using no sources
items.answer: A) including only the most relevant details and keeping the flow

solution.answer: A) including only the most relevant details and keeping the flow

items.prompt:
A student copies three sentences from a website word-for-word with no quotation marks or citation. This is:
A) plagiarism
B) correct paraphrasing
C) proper quoting

steps: No credit or marks. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Which source is MOST authoritative for a report on vaccine safety?
A) a peer-reviewed study from a medical journal
B) an anonymous social media post
C) a satirical website
items.answer: A) a peer-reviewed study from a medical journal

solution.answer: A) a peer-reviewed study from a medical journal
